# BPM / Laws+ compatibility patch - common/scripted_triggers
# Generated by tools/build.py. Do not rename: the zzzzzzzzzz_ prefix keeps
# these files last in the ASCII order the game resolves conflicts by.

# coa_fascist_trigger
REPLACE:coa_fascist_trigger = {
	bpm_country_is_fascist = yes
	OR = {
		has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_corporate_state
		has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_social_monarchy
		ruler ?= {
			OR = {
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_fascist
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_integralist
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_clerical_fascist
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_national_socialist
			}
		}
	}
}

# ig_is_reactionary
REPLACE:ig_is_reactionary = {
	OR = {
		bpm_ig_is_traditionalist = yes
		leader = {
			bpm_leader_is_reactionary = yes
			OR = {
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_slaver
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_fascist
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_integralist
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_royalist
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_orleanist
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_theocrat
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_clerical_fascist
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_national_socialist
			}
		}
	}
}
